item.name: Snorflord
item.howToStart: Sail to the island where Snorflord spawns and engage the fight on land.
item.rewardLead: May drop medkits. Medkits are also reported under benches near the spawn area.
item.prepNotes: Bring mid-game weapons, healing, and inventory space before challenging the island.
item.cardSummary: A mid-run island boss players hunt for combat practice and emergency healing. Treat medkit rewards as a soft lead, not a guaranteed drop table.

item.name: The Kraken
item.howToStart: Defend the raft when the Kraken attack begins at sea, usually as a night or late-run pressure event.
item.prepNotes: Stock guns, ammo, raft defenses, and healing. Keep a retreat path on the raft while focusing tentacles and the main body.
item.relatedEncounters: Not the same fight as Ancient Squid / Squid Boss
item.cardSummary: A major open-sea raid that attacks your raft rather than a fixed island arena. This is a different encounter from the tablet-summoned Squid Boss.

item.name: Ghost Galleon
item.howToStart: Enter the Ghost Galleon dungeon or summoned ghost-ship route and clear the encounter. Completing it three times in one run unlocks a public badge.
item.rewardLead: Ghost pirate loot and galleon progression leads such as ghost cutlass or galleon bell gear may appear after clears.
item.prepNotes: Bring weapons for mixed melee and gunner ghosts, healing, and space to record badge progress across multiple clears.
item.cardSummary: A repeatable ghost-ship combat objective tied to the public Third Bell Rung badge. Closely related to Captain Greenbeard and other ghost-pirate stronghold content.

item.name: Captain Greenbeard
item.howToStart: Progress ghost-pirate stronghold or ghost-ship content until the Greenbeard fight begins on the ship route.
item.prepNotes: Expect a tougher ghost-pirate climax fight. Bring strong weapons, healing, and crew support if possible.
item.cardSummary: The named ghost-ship boss often treated as a late pirate climax. Keep it cross-linked with Ghost Galleon content rather than treating the two names as unrelated systems.

item.name: Fire Golems
item.howToStart: Defeat three Fire Golems in the Volcano region, then throw their bodies into the volcano crater to unlock the deeper fight.
item.rewardLead: Unlocks the volcano route for Lord of Lava rather than acting as the final volcano reward.
item.prepNotes: Clear space, keep healing in reserve, and do not enter the volcano chain with a weak raft retreat plan.
item.cardSummary: Three Fire Golems form the Volcano unlock step. The public Cooking With Golems badge confirms you toss three golems into the volcano before the main boss.

item.name: Lord of Lava
item.howToStart: After unlocking the volcano with three Fire Golem bodies, jump into the volcano arena and fight Lord of Lava.
item.rewardLead: Volcano videos show a Magma Chest after the fight, with Magma Staff as a reward lead. Magma Staff is also the Fire Mage class starter, so do not treat it as boss-only.
item.prepNotes: Prepare like a full boss: tested weapons, healing reserve, inventory space for chest UI, and a way back to the raft.
item.cardSummary: The main Volcano boss confirmed by the Beat The Heat badge. Clear Fire Golems first, then fight in the volcano arena for the Magma Chest reward lead.

item.name: Yeti
item.howToStart: Travel to the Ice Region and complete the local summon setup, then fight the Ice Biome boss when it spawns.
item.prepNotes: Prepare for cold-region travel first, then bring weapons, healing, and a safe retreat path before the boss spawn.
item.cardSummary: The Ice Region boss community guides call Yeti. The public King Of The Snow badge confirms defeating the Ice Biome boss without printing a different official HUD name.

item.name: Ancient Squid
item.howToStart: Find and activate the Ancient Tablets on the map, then fight the Squid Boss when the summon completes.
item.rewardLead: Defeating the Squid Boss unlocks the Arms of Victory badge. Squid Laser is associated with Ancient Squid progression and the Ancient Squid class, not proven as a full drop table here.
item.prepNotes: Treat this as a planned endgame-style summon. Bring strong weapons, healing, and ammo or special tools before activating the final tablet steps.
item.relatedEncounters: Not the same fight as The Kraken
item.cardSummary: A tablet-summoned Squid Boss tracked by the Arms of Victory badge. Keep it separate from The Kraken sea raid even though both are large sea monsters.
